notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B analytics SaaS focused on product telemetry and user insights. Initially tried Redwood hosted API for rapid integration (chat assistant + semantic search). POC showed good quality but unit cost variability is driver to evaluate Dedicated/VPC for cost predictability and data controls.

Key technical requirements / quotes from customer: “We need provable controls that user data never leaves our VPC and full audit trail retained 1 year minimum. SOC2 attestation and SAML SSO are gating items for procurement.” - CTO

POC details: sandbox dataset ~12k docs (English), embeddings pipeline 8k qps batch goal, end-to-end search latency target p95 <150ms for embeddings+knn. Chat assistant SLA: p95 generation latency <250ms, concurrency target 40 simultaneous agents. Experimented with hosted_api under burst traffic; saw cost spikes during heavy nightly ingestion. Recommend Dedicated with autoscale + burst capacity.

Security review specifics requested: SOC2 Type II report (latest), SAML IdP metadata + example SSO flow, audit log retention options and export paths (CloudWatch/ELK or SFTP), KMS/HSM key control, encryption-at-rest details, data residency guarantees for EU region, DPA with data processing terms. They also want ability to limit model variants allowed inside the VPC to prevent accidental fallback to external models.

Commercial: looking for committed RU tiers (monthly) with predictable egress/cost. Estimated ARR range they quoted to procurement: $60k-$120k. Decision makers: CTO (security), VP Product (value), Head of Finance (budget).

Next steps (short): send Dedicated pricing + SOC2 artifacts, provide SAML config guide and sample metadata, schedule deep-dive w/ customer infra + security (30-45m), produce committed RU options and sample contract language for residency.

use_case_summary: Evaluating hosted_api to prototype chat and semantic search, moving to Dedicated/VPC for production to meet security and cost predictability. Primary workloads: embeddings for retrieval, reranking for result ordering, chat for support agent augmentation.
poC_metrics: Load test targets: 100 RPS sustained embeddings ingestion; embeddings pipeline target p95 <150ms; chat generation p95 <250ms; concurrency 40 sessions. Failure tolerance: automatic fallback to lighter model within same VPC only.
